resources.string: Save your sources and favourites to a file, or restore them from one. Passwords are never written to the file — you will re-enter them after importing.
That file could not be read as a Quiblo backup.
That backup was written by a newer version of Quiblo (format %1$d, this build reads %2$d). Update the app and try again.
Nothing to restore — everything in that file is already set up.
Quiblo is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later. It ships the following third-party components.
How far the skip buttons jump.
More buffer rides out a poor connection but starts slower. Applies to the next stream you open, not the one already playing.
Caps video bitrate on streams that offer several qualities. Streams with only one quality are unaffected.

Optionally show a description, genres, rating, certificate, director and cast on movie screens, using your own account with The Movie Database. Off by default — Quiblo ships no key of its own and contacts nothing until you add one.
TMDB API key or read access token
Key accepted. Film information is on.
The Movie Database rejected that key. Nothing was saved.
Turned off. The key was removed.
Off. No requests are made to The Movie Database.
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Fill in every film and series
Looks up your whole catalogue once, so genres and scores are there before you browse. On a large playlist this takes a while — you can leave this screen, and it picks up where it stopped.
Working out what needs looking up…
Stopped. %1$d titles kept — starting again carries on from here.
The Movie Database asked us to slow down, so the scan stopped. %1$d titles kept. Try again later.
The Movie Database rejected the key. %1$d titles kept. Check the key above.
The Movie Database could not be reached. %1$d titles kept. Check your connection and try again.

Providers often list one film several times — SD, HD, 4K, a subtitled cut. Turn this on to see it once, with the other copies offered on the film\'s own screen. Off shows everything your provider sent.
Providers file the same film under several categories — FILMS HD, FILMS 4K, FILMS AR. Turn this on to drop the shelves and browse everything in one grid.
Which sections appear in the navigation bar. At least one has to stay on.

Quiblo is installed from an APK, so nothing tells you when a newer one exists. On, the app asks its own releases page once each time it opens and offers the update if there is one. Off makes no request at all.
Quiblo %1$s has been released. You are on %2$s.

Turn categories off to hide them from browsing, or rename them. These are yours alone — everyone else on this device keeps their own list. Both are local: nothing is sent to your provider, and hiding removes nothing.
No categories in this section yet.
Your provider calls this "%1$s". Renaming changes only what you see.
Hide titles written in a script you do not read. Nothing is hidden until you pick one, and your favourites are never hidden.
Follow your device, or pick one and keep it.
Android 12 and later. Off keeps the app’s own colours.
Fill in logos for live channels your playlist doesn’t provide one for, using the community-maintained iptv-org channel list.
On. The channel list is downloaded once — a few megabytes — and refreshed about every two weeks. Your playlist’s own logos are always used where it has them.
Off. Nothing is downloaded and iptv-org is never contacted.
Channel data from the iptv-org project.
Favourites and continue watching belong to this profile. Playlists and settings are shared.
Guest — favourites and continue watching are deleted when this session ends.
